issues.title: 2026 manuring progress contradicts
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 (visit 25 Feb 2026) says no fertiliser applied or received in 2026 (0 of 295.15 mt) and Mix B for P02D not applied due to weedy circles. PA 1/2026 shows Jan Mix B 19.90 mt and Feb Mix B 21.45 mt both 100% applied, plus 5.51 mt Mix A in January, i.e. 46.86 mt applied by end-February.

issues.title: Harvester count 15 vs 25
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 labour table shows 15 harvesters of 26 workers (requirement 12), but the PA summary page says 26 workers including 25 harvesters.

issues.title: P02D harvester earnings copied
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Table 12: P02D 2.27 mt/day at RM49.00/mt gives RM111.23/day, but the table shows RM135.73 (same as P99C). The stated earnings range RM102.44–RM135.73 is therefore overstated at the top for P02D.

issues.title: Circle sprayer earnings arithmetic
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Table 7: circle spraying 6.0 ha/day at RM13.00/ha = RM78.00/day, but stated RM69.00. Table is also titled Jan–June 2026 though the review period is Jan–Apr.

issues.title: Pruning total % and remaining area
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Table 10: 215.13 of 242.08 ha = 88.87%, stated 89.23%. Text says about 15% of P99C/P02D still under corrective pruning; table shows 18.78 ha (19%) of P99C and 8.17 ha (11%) of P02D outstanding. Agro 1/2026 (Feb) said only about 5 ha remained in P99C, to finish early March 2026.

issues.title: Budget yield 20.25 t/ha uses total area
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 7.5 states the 2026 budget as 20.25 t/ha (6,275 mt); 6,275 mt over 242.08 mature ha is 25.92 t/ha. 20.25 only results from dividing by the full 309.82 ha including replant and office.

issues.title: Replant area 66 vs 67 ha
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Table 1 shows P25B 66.00 ha, immature 66.74 ha and planted 308.82 ha, while PA text (2.1, 8.1) and Agro 1/2026 give P25B 67.00 ha and replant 67.74 ha. P25E is labelled P26E in the table, with SPH 136 vs 135 in text 8.2.3.

issues.title: Rainfall days do not add
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 Table 2: Jul–Dec 2025 rain days 8+9+11+12+17+11 = 68, but total shown 66 (and 10-month total 93). Agro 1/2026 records July 2025 as 6 rain days, which gives 66.

issues.title: Harvester ratio
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 4.2 says 15 harvesters gives 1 harvester to 21 ha; on the 242.08 ha mature area it is about 1 to 16 ha (21 ha only on total 309.82 ha).

issues.title: Mix B carry-forward 21.35 vs 21.45 mt
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 Table 3/4 shows Mix B balance 21.35 mt (181.15 - 159.80) carried to 2026; text 3.1 says 21.45 mt.

issues.title: Average palm density 101/ha misleading
issues.detail: Agro 1/2026 states average density 101 palms/ha, i.e. 31,285 palms over all 309.82 ha including unplanted replant. Over the 242.08 ha mature area it is about 129, consistent with PA 1/2026 average 128.

issues.title: Block name typos
issues.detail: PA 1/2026 10.7 refers to field P15C (no such field; P15A meant per 5.4.2). Agro 1/2026 Table 8 lists P09C (P99C meant).

kb:
SIMPANG DURIAN ESTATE - FACT PACK (Ria Gemilang Sdn Bhd, Prosper group). Acquired by Prosper Group in March 2025. Located in Jelebu district, Negeri Sembilan, described as Malaysia's driest region. Plantation Controller Dr Chua Chin Kok; Senior Visiting Manager En. Mat Zin Bin Mat Akir; estate run by En Mohamad Syukri Bin Ahmad (named Estate Manager on PA cover and Manager on Agronomy cover; Assistant In-Charge in PA staff table, transferred in 6 October 2025).

SOURCES. (1) PA Report 1/2026 (Planting Advisory), visit 20 April 2026, review period January to April 2026, by Tn Hj Mohd Sufian Bin Yusoff (Planting Advisor). Previous PA visit 23 October 2025; second visit since acquisition. No estate costing figures in the report. (2) Agronomy Report 1/2026, visit 25 February 2026, prepared by Muhammad Ghazali Bin Abdul Ghani (Junior Agronomist) and Chong Kuan Ming (Senior Agronomist). Previous agronomy visit 3 September 2025.

AREA (PA, April 2026). Total 309.82 ha: planted 308.82 ha plus office/housing 1.00 ha. Mature 242.08 ha (78.39%): P15A 70.13 ha, SPH 136, DxP GH 500, 22.71%; P99C 98.78 ha, SPH 124, DxP Chemara, 31.99%; P02D 73.17 ha, SPH 126, DxP Chemara, 23.69%; average 128 SPH. Immature 66.74 ha in table: P25B 66.00 ha SPH 148 (DxP IOI Deli Avros) and P25E 0.74 ha SPH 136 (labelled P26E). Text says 67.74 ha immature and P25B 67.00 ha. Age profile: immature 66.74 ha (21.61%), young prime 9-13 yrs 70.13 ha (22.71%), old mature over 18 yrs 171.95 ha (55.68%). Terrain 75% flat to gently undulating, 25% hilly with terraces. PARAS GIS palm counting done; SPH updated.
Agronomy blocking: P99C 98.78, P02D 73.17, P15A 70.13 (mature 242.08); replanting PR25B 67.00, PR25E 0.74 (67.74); total 309.82 ha. Census (Sept 2025): total 31,285 palms; P15A1 38.01 ha 5,389 palms 142 SPH; P15A2 32.12 ha 4,261 palms 133 SPH; P99C1 57.34 ha 7,441 palms 130; P99C2 41.44 ha 4,934 palms 119; P02D1 40.61 ha 5,335 palms 131; P02D2 32.56 ha 3,925 palms 121; replant blocks 0 palms at census. Agronomist states average density 101 palms/ha (all 309.82 ha incl. unplanted replant). 32% of planted area is older than 26 years and taller than 45 feet. P02D approaching replanting; P15A 11 years old, prime. Future replanting programme not finalised.

STAFF (PA). Adequate. Mohamad Syukri Bin Ahmad, Assistant In-Charge (36). Mohamad Syawal Fitri Bin Jamil, Field Supervisor (from Sri Sisek, 6 Oct 2025). Puputfikaria Susanto Binti Wagi, General Clerk (Mar 2026, replacing Pn Fatiha Suraya transferred to Ladang Simpai). Assistant Manager Muhammad Nurhafizi transferred to Ladang Simpai Feb 2026. Two security guards.

LABOUR (PA, April 2026). 26 workers vs 23 required: harvesters 15 vs 12, driver/loader 2/2, field workers 7/7, watchman 2/2. Ratio 1 worker per 12 ha; text says 1 harvester per 21 ha. 3 Mechanical Buffalo (Badang) units for in-field collection. 10 Indonesian workers received November 2025, mainly harvesting. PA summary item says 26 workers including 25 harvesters (conflicts with table 15). Agronomy: January 2026 production low due to harvester shortage; P15A had only 1 round in January.

WEEDING (PA, Jan-Apr 2026). Circle spraying 242.08 ha done vs 171.95 ha programme (1.0 round; year programme 726.24 ha). Selective spraying 340.86 ha vs 242.08 (1.4 rounds; P99C twice). Ahead of schedule, satisfactory; soft grasses retained. Circle raking needed after pruning in P99C and P02D; estate to skip one circle spraying round and use budget for raking. Glyphosate circle spray limited to 2 m radius. Sprayer rates: circle RM13.00/ha, 6.0 ha/day, stated RM69.00/day (CDA); selective RM14.00/ha, 5.0 ha/day, RM70.00/day (mist blower). Agronomy (Feb 2026): 2025 achieved 2 of 3 budgeted rounds of interrow and circle weeding in all mature blocks; 2026 weeding in P99C/P02D not yet started at visit; weedy circles with volunteer oil palm seedlings; Urena lobata, Clidemia hirta, Ageratum in P15A.

MANURING. PA: as of April 2026, 64.26 mt Mix A and Mix B applied, 40% of 1st half programme of 164.60 mt; 94.26 mt received. Jan Mix A 26.85 required, 5.51 applied (21%); Jan Mix B 19.90 applied (100%); Feb Mix B 21.45 (100%); Apr Mix A 23.50 required, 8.66 received, 0 applied; Apr Mix B 17.40 (100%); May Mix B 21.45 and Jun RP 34.05 to come. Mix A delayed by late delivery. Fertiliser had been skipped for 2 years before takeover. Manurer rates: over 2.0 kg RM2.30/bag, 30 bags, RM69.00/day; under 2.0 kg RM2.70/bag, 25 bags, RM67.50/day. Suggest Mechanical Buffalo or Timac semi-mechanised application.
Agronomy: 2025 manuring 89% (213.94 of 239.89 mt): Mix B 159.80 of 181.15 mt (88%), RP 54.14 of 58.74 (92%); Mix B balance 21.35 mt carried to 2026 (text says 21.45). 2026 requirement 295.15 mt (Mix A 100.70, Mix B 160.40, RP 34.05); at the 25 Feb visit 0 mt applied and 0 received; Mix A not delivered; Mix B for P02D not applied due to weedy, debris-covered circles; caking of fertiliser in P15A2 from previous round. 2026 programme unchanged (kg/palm): P99C Mix A 2.00, 1.75, 2.00, 1.75; P02D Mix B 2.00, 1.75, 2.00, 1.75 plus RP 1.50; P15A Mix B 2.25 x4 plus RP 2.00; PR25 CRF and RP in planting hole, then Compound 0.80, RP 1.50, Compound 0.90.
